FileVault.//RootPath: The folder inside the container. docker-compose mounts the host folder here read-only.
FileVault.//RequestPath: Files are served under this prefix. Set it to "" to serve them at the site root.
FileVault.//AllowedExtensions: Only these leave the container. Everything else is a 404, whatever else is in the mounted folder.
FileVault.//Svg: '.svg' is deliberately absent: an SVG can carry script, and serving one inline runs it on this origin.
